Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast ein klares Verständnis für saubere Prozesse und weißt, wie wichtig Verlässlichkeit im Vertrieb ist? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.
Deine Aufgaben
Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.
Pflege stabiler Kundenbeziehungen: Saubere Betreuung mit nachvollziehbaren Abläufen, festen Schritten und dokumentierten Follow-ups.
Vertriebsprozesse umsetzen: Einhaltung von Standards, Arbeit mit KPIs und Sicherstellung, dass kein Schritt ausgelassen wird.
Teamverantwortung übernehmen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, klare Übergaben und Orientierung durch feste Strukturen.
Was wir dir bieten
Stabilität & Klarheit: Strukturierte Prozesse, feste Zuständigkeiten und ein durchdachtes Vertriebssystem.
Arbeitsplatz mit Planbarkeit: Geregelte Abläufe, messbare Ergebnisse und ein klarer Erwartungshorizont.
Büro in München: Konzentrationsfördernde Umgebung mit klarer Aufgabentrennung und ruhiger Atmosphäre.
Strukturiertes Onboarding: Systematische Einarbeitung, Schritt für Schritt.
Teamorientierte Umsetzung: Jeder kennt seinen Bereich, alles greift ineinander, ohne Reibungsverluste.
Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
Freude an Zielen, Zahlen und dem sichtbaren Erfolg von klaren Abläufen.
Unternehmerisches Denken, strukturierte Umsetzung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
Klare Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, sachlich, effizient, ohne Umwege.
Führung mit Struktur, nicht mit Vision, sondern mit System.

QuickTeam helps US businesses grow by placing high-quality offshore talent — trained, vetted, and ready to work — at a fraction of the cost of hiring locally. We handle recruiting, onboarding, and client support from end to end. We're growing fast and looking for closers who want to be paid for what they actually produce. How this is different?

Most commission roles pay you once per deal and move on. This one keeps paying. Every month a client's virtual assistant is working, you earn. Close a client once, and that account generates income for as long as the VA stays — and our VAs typically stay for years. You're also not starting from scratch.

We have a dedicated lead specialist who continuously researches, qualifies, and contextualizes leads for you, so you're always working a warm pipeline. Your job is to close, not to build a list. What you get Warm, contextualized leads — a dedicated member of our team constantly builds and prepares your pipeline. You come in warm, not cold.

Recurring income — your commission is tied to hours billed by the VAs you place. Active placements mean monthly income, month after month, with no additional effort on your part. Long-term compounding upside — clients who stay for two or three years keep paying you the whole time. Your book of business grows and compounds.

Uncapped earnings in USD — no territory limits, no income ceiling. Full tools and access — CRM, dialer, email, and everything you need to work deals effectively. Backend handled for you — we manage recruiting, onboarding, and ongoing client delivery so you stay focused on selling.

What earnings look like Because commission is tied to hours worked rather than a flat placement fee, income compounds as your book grows. A modest base of a few active long-term clients generates meaningful recurring monthly income in USD — and that base keeps building as you close more.

The commission structure is competitive and discussed in full during the interview. How it works You apply and we walk you through the model, the leads, and the comp. We get you set up with tools and access. You start working leads and closing deals. You get paid — and keep getting paid every month your clients stay active.

Requirements What we're looking for Proven B2B sales or closing experience — staffing, services, SaaS, or similar preferred Exceptional spoken English is non-negotiable. This role is 100% phone-based selling to US business owners and decision makers.

Your voice, clarity, and confidence on a cold call is your product — if a prospect would hesitate for even a moment based on how you sound, this isn't the right fit. Candidates with a neutral, natural-sounding English accent are strongly preferred.

Comfortable working US EST/PST business hours Comfortable working leads by phone, email, and LinkedIn Self-motivated and disciplined — you don't need a manager over your shoulder Experience selling to or supporting US-based clients is a strong advantage Coachable, organized, and consistent in follow-up Hungry for uncapped, USD-denominated, performance-based income This role is not for Anyone expecting a base salary or guaranteed hourly pay People who need constant supervision or hand-holding Reps looking for a 9-to-5 with a predictable paycheck Originally posted on Himalayas

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an "I can do that" mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance. FOR POSITIONS AT GAS STATIONS ONLY: May assist with regular fuel lane maintenance including the handling and cleanup of hazardous materials or substances. Must wear appropriate PPE when required.

Must pass and maintain current fuel safety training as required.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Job Description
Turnitin is seeking a disciplined, resourceful, and self-driven Sales Development Representative to drive sales growth by strategically prospecting into new accounts and identifying high-quality leads for the sales team.

You will understand the Turnitin Integrity and Assessment product portfolios to assess potential customers' needs, mitigate objections, and position the right solutions.

You will own the relationship until the prospect is qualified and ready to engage with a sales account executive, allowing them to focus on closing deals while you focus on generating new opportunities.

Strategic Planning & Prospecting: Conduct market research and analysis to inform go-to-market strategy. Collaborate with your regional sales team to develop and execute a dynamic territory plan, identifying key opportunities and ensuring all activities have measurable outcomes.
Lead Generation: Actively prospect into assigned territories to generate new leads. Develop and execute targeted multi-touch inbound and outbound campaigns via social media, email, and phone to drive engagement and build a robust pipeline.
Lead Qualification & Advancement: Follow up on, qualify, and nurture all assigned leads. Navigate institutional buying processes by mapping key decision-makers and influencers. Skillfully mitigate prospect objections by clarifying concerns and responding with well-prepared solutions.
Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the sales team to determine the next steps for each prospect. Keep the sales team informed on project statuses, ensuring all relevant CRM systems (like Salesforce.com) are updated in real-time.
Performance & Development: Achieve or exceed all assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Manage detailed prospect account lists, diligently tracking lead progress. Continuously learn and develop your technical, competitive, and sales skills.

· Assist in training and mentoring new sales hires to compress their time-to-quota and keep existing reps sharp on GTM processes.
· Maintain and curate a ready-to-go library of case studies, white papers, and technical one-pagers for immediate field deployment.

The SDR, Strategic Accounts is responsible for generating new business opportunities across both prospective and existing customer accounts. The role focuses on strategic account development, identifying high-value opportunities within complex organizations and creating meaningful engagement with the right stakeholders.
For prospective accounts , the SDR owns outbound prospecting efforts to identify and create new opportunities within high-priority strategic accounts. This includes researching accounts, identifying key stakeholders and buying groups, leveraging intent and account signals, and developing personalized outreach that creates meaningful sales conversations.
For customer accounts , the focus shifts toward expansion . The SDR partners closely with Account Directors and other customer-facing teams to identify whitespace, new teams or business units, additional use cases, and other signals that may indicate an opportunity for growth. The SDR helps create new relationships within existing customers and generates qualified expansion opportunities for the account team.
Across both motions, the SDR is expected to take an account-based approach rather than simply prospecting individual contacts. This means understanding the broader organization, mapping relevant stakeholders, identifying business priorities and potential use cases, and coordinating outreach across multiple personas where appropriate.
The role also supports strategic account planning by surfacing relevant insights, engagement signals, and prospect intelligence that can help Account Directors prioritize where to focus their efforts.

Prospect into high-priority strategic accounts to create net-new business opportunities.
Identify and engage decision-makers, influencers, champions, and other members of relevant buying groups.
Develop account and stakeholder maps to understand organizational structure, priorities, and potential opportunities.
Research and leverage intent, engagement, organizational, and other account-level signals to prioritize outreach.
Create personalized, multi-channel prospecting campaigns tailored to the account and stakeholder.
Identify expansion opportunities within existing customers, including new teams, departments, business units, and use cases.
Partner with Account Directors on account strategy, whitespace identification, and coordinated outreach.
Generate qualified meetings and opportunities that align with the strategic account's potential and business priorities.
Maintain accurate account and contact intelligence in Salesforce and relevant sales development tools.
Provide Account Directors with actionable prospect intelligence, including organizational changes, initiatives, pain points, and relevant buying signals.
Contribute to strategic account plans and broader ABX initiatives across priority accounts.

At least 1+ years in a client-facing role
Excellent organization, prioritization, and communication skills
Able to work independently in an entrepreneurial environment; adaptive to change
Track record of exceeding goals based on defined KPIs
A passion for generating new business
Willingness to work in a collaborative work environment with multiple stakeholders
Highly motivated, disciplined, and reliable
Intellectually curious, always willing to learn and continuously improve

Who are we?
We’re Invisible’s Growth Team. We are an irreplaceable strategic growth partner for the world's fastest growing & most innovative companies, powering their digital workflows so they can focus on building their businesses - not running them.
The Job
Reporting to the Head of Sales, you will be our first sales development representative (SDR). We are looking for a passionate individual eager to play a key role in driving the go-to-market efforts of a fast-growing company that will be the next iconic brand (imagine being the first SDR at Amazon or Google).

The goal of the SDR is to help enable Invisible’s mission to automate repetitive work for every company so people can focus on their real work by developing leads that can be directed to Account Executives for closing.

You will be responsible for developing and executing an outbound outreach program to reach our key target accounts, achieve our monthly sales targets, and play a key role in helping us grow 3x again in 2022.
Who We Want
Sales Development will be an important member of the Sales team. Our ability to achieve our goals comes down, in a large part, to the type and number of clients you will add. We are looking for individuals with the full spectrum of abilities and we are extremely selective. The ideal candidate is a blend of 3 key strengths:
1) You have demonstrated success in achieving quota and running outbound initiatives
2) The right candidate will find a way in to each of our target accounts, having a ‘hunter-mentality’ to find a way into each target and to win
3) You have experience with outbound methodologies beyond just emails and cold calls, you have strong competitive DNA and are always looking for creative ways to prospect
This ‘hunter-mentality’ is key to continuing our high growth trajectory: we grew 3x in 2020, 4x in 2021, and plan to grow rapidly by 3x again in 2022. We are looking for individuals with the full spectrum of abilities and we are extremely selective.
